name: ALD
description:
Aladdin can be defined in one sentence as: a global gateway hub for real projects to enter Web3.

ALD does not bet on any short-term project, nor does it rely on any particular market sentiment. What ALD truly values ​​are projects with real business, real assets, real users, and real industry resources, and is exploring new paths to enter Web3.

In the past, many Web3 projects first created a narrative and then sought supporting elements. ALD chose the opposite path: first find real projects, and then establish on-chain representation, community entry points, market awareness, and ecosystem development for them.

This is not a single speculative move, but a long-term project to migrate real-world projects to the Web3 world.
